20261122-chemistry-m1-1.topic: Kumacala omabini ombhobho omde weglasi kwafakwa

20261122-chemistry-m1-1.material: [Isantya sokusasazeka esinzulu] Kumacala omabini ombhobho omde weglasi kwafakwa ukotini ofakwe kwi-ammonia egxininisiweyo (ubunzima beemolekyuli 17) nokotini ofakwe kwi-hydrochloric acid egxininisiweyo (ubunzima beemolekyuli 36.5) ngaxeshanye, yaza yavalwa ngezivalo zerabha. Emva kwexesha elifutshane kwavela ibhanti lomsi omhlophe (i-ammonium chloride) ngaphakathi kombhobho, ngaphakathi kwendawo eyiphi ekwi-ammonia okanye ekwi-hydrochloric acid ebinakuyimeli ngakumbi?

20261121-chemistry-m2-2.s.s1.explain: Xa i-silver ion ($\text{Ag}^+$) yesisombululo se-silver nitrate ne-chloride ion ($\text{Cl}^-$) emanzini zisabela, zenza i-precipitate emhlophe ye-silver chloride ($\text{AgCl}$) engananyibilikiyo emanzini, ngoko i-chloride ion inokufunyanwa.
